shell.footer: A space to move, practice and grow.

home.title:
Make room
for your rhythm.
home.description: A home for your dance journey. Start with a little practice. See where it takes you.
home.sectionDescription: Practice comes first. Community, events and battles are part of the journey ahead.
home.practiceDescription: Simple tools that fit your training. Open to everyone, no account needed.
home.connectDescription: A place for the dance community to connect. Coming in a future phase.
home.growDescription: More ways to explore events and battles. Planned for the future.
home.metaDescription: A guest-first home for dance practice, starting with Playground.

playground.title: Your practice. Your playground.
playground.description: Small tools for the work behind the movement. No account required.
playground.toolDescription: Make space for focused rounds and intentional breaks. Our first practice tool is on its way.
playground.metaDescription: Discover public dance practice tools. Start with the Practice Timer preview.

practiceTimer.title: Every round starts here.
practiceTimer.notice: This is a preview of our first practice tool. Timing controls, rounds and presets will arrive in a later phase.
practiceTimer.metaDescription: Preview the future guest-first Practice Timer. The timer is not implemented yet.

identity.loginDescription: Continue your dance journey with your account.
identity.registerDescription: Register with email and confirm your address to continue.
identity.metaDescription: Secure access to your Dance Platform account.
identity.forgotDescription: We will send a recovery link if the account is eligible.
identity.resetDescription: Choose a new password for your verified account.
identity.confirmationPending: Check your email for a confirmation link. If you already have an account, you can log in.
identity.recoveryPending: If an eligible account exists, a recovery email has been sent. Check your inbox.
identity.resetSuccess: Your password has been updated. You can continue to your account.
identity.accountDescription: Your verified identity and private profile status.
identity.retryDescription: You are signed in. Profile initialization could not finish. Please retry.
identity.validation: Check your email and password fields. Passwords must match.
identity.credentials: Unable to sign in. Check your credentials and confirm your email.
identity.invalidLink: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new link.
identity.unavailable: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
identity.rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
identity.passwordPolicy: Use a different password with 8–128 characters.

profile.title: My Profile
profile.description: Manage your profile presentation and private account data.
profile.usernameHint: Optional: 3-30 lowercase letters, digits or underscores; start with a letter.
profile.renameWarning: Changing or clearing your username makes the old name immediately available to others. Old links will not redirect. Your account identity stays the same.
profile.saved: Profile saved. Current server data is displayed.
profile.currentChanged: Current profile reloaded. Another change may have updated your data.
profile.validation_failed: Check the profile fields: username format, name up to 80 characters and bio up to 500 characters.
profile.revision_conflict: Your profile changed elsewhere. Your draft is kept. Reload current profile before editing again.
profile.username_unavailable: This username is unavailable. Choose another name.
profile.outcome_unknown: The save outcome could not be confirmed. Your draft is kept. Reload current profile before saving again.
profile.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Return to your account to sign in.
profile.account_unavailable: This account is unavailable for editing.
profile.bootstrap_incomplete: Your profile is not ready. Return to your account and retry initialization.
profile.service_unavailable: Profile service is temporarily unavailable. Your draft is kept; try reloading.
profile.completionNotice: Choose a unique username and display name to continue. Completing your profile makes your username, display name and optional bio public. Profiles are not indexed by search engines.
profile.completion_required: Enter a valid username and display name to complete your public profile. Bio is optional.
profile.publicServiceUnavailable: Profiles are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
profile.avatarTooLarge: Photo too large. Maximum size: 2 MB.
profile.avatarOutcomeUnknown: Reload current profile before another change.
profile.avatarRateLimited: Too many uploads. Try again later.
